notablePrerequisites:
You control at least 5 Dwarfs who do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block.
description:
Attack with 5 Dwarfs, triggering Magda to create 5 Treasure tokens.
Sacrifice the 5 Treasure tokens for {3}{R}{R}.
Pay {3}{R}{R} to Aggravated Assault, gaining an extra combat phase and untapping all your creatures.
Repeat.
